Deeper still lies a band with small red blood spots. That trio of thick top, thin middle and blood rich wrap tells you the skin has truly grown under the dome.

Text notes weekly fills over eight to twelve weeks. Small repeated fills let the skin grow gradually without undue tension, which is why the schedule spans months.
